_doc: One file per place. build.py renders /states/<slug>/ (kind=state) from this file. Every number must be an official published figure with its source. Amounts in US dollars. Headline is Census state + local debt (same source and definition for every state). Generated by pipeline/census_state.py.
name: North Dakota
title: North Dakota Debt Clock: Live State and Local Debt, From Official Data
cadence: Annual. The Census Bureau's Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances comes out about two years after the fiscal year (survey year 2024: July 2026; survey year 2023: July 2025).
next_update: The next Census figures, for survey year 2025, are expected around mid-2027, based on the last two release dates.
fiscal_year_end_note: North Dakota's state fiscal year ends June 30. Census survey year 2024 covers each government's fiscal year that ended between July 1, 2023 and June 30, 2024; the clock dates it June 30, 2024, the end of that window.

population.source_name: Census Bureau, Vintage 2025 state population estimates (NST-EST2025)

components.label: State government debt
components.source_name: US Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, table GS00LOCALFIN (State and Local Government Finances by Level of Government: U.S. and States: 2017-2024), Debt - Total Debt Outstanding (LF0231)
components.source_locator: North Dakota, Government type 'State', items LF0231 Total, LF0233 Long-term and LF0232 Short-term Debt Outstanding, survey year 2024; amounts published in $1,000
components.includes: All debt of the North Dakota state government as Census defines it: long-term and short-term debt of the state and its dependent agencies, whatever the source of repayment. Census uses the same definition for every state.

components.label: Local government debt
components.source_name: US Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, table GS00LOCALFIN (State and Local Government Finances by Level of Government: U.S. and States: 2017-2024), Debt - Total Debt Outstanding (LF0231)
components.source_locator: North Dakota, Government type 'Local', items LF0231 Total, LF0233 Long-term and LF0232 Short-term Debt Outstanding, survey year 2024; amounts published in $1,000
components.includes: All debt of North Dakota's counties, cities, towns, school districts and special districts, on the same Census definition. Census estimates local totals from a sample of local governments in most years (2022 was a full count, the Census of Governments); coefficient of variation for 2024: 0.91%.

extra_sources.name: US Census Bureau, 2024 State & Local Government Finance Datasets and Tables (release page)
US Census Bureau, 2024 Annual Survey of Local Government Finances methodology
Census data API download used for these figures (North Dakota)

notes: Census publishes North Dakota's state + local total as $9.67 billion for 2024 (coefficient of variation 0.45%) and $9.01 billion for 2023. State + local here is exactly Census's state figure plus its local figure.

Census's figures are the newest official state + local totals that use one definition for all 50 states, but they lag about two years, so the live clock projects from June 30, 2024. North Dakota's own audited report is fresher but is not used here: it covers a narrower scope and would not be comparable with the other states.
Not included: unfunded pension and retiree-health liabilities, and the state's share of the federal debt.
legend: North Dakota state + local debt is reported once a year by the Census Bureau, about two years after the fact. Real borrowing happens in lumps when bonds are sold and is repaid on schedules, so the live number is a straight-line projection from the latest Census year, shown here next to the official totals.
